rule: balance diff = 0 (só lifecycle de saída da parceria pode mudar)

severance.rule: dismissal always succeeds; penalty = 50% of monthly cost when contract still running; becomes debt (termination_funded_by_debt) when penalty > coins

partnerPolicy.levelFitRule: 100 − 4 × max(0, playerOVR − candidateOVR); sem bônus acima do nível
partnerPolicy.renewalRule: Normal v3 renova só se score(atual) ≥ renewVsMarket × melhor score da Busca (e razão OVR ≥ renewMinPartnerShare)
